notes.title: 17/09/25 - Neonscape
notes.content:
An assortment of changes this time around.

[list]
[*] Updated from Godot 4.4 -> 4.5. You may see some minor performence improvements on levels as a result of this.
[*] Some world 6 assets are available to view in a WIP level. Welcome to the Neonscape.
[*] Removed the last spring from level 2-2 as it didn't want to work. The player just needs to wall jump up the cave shaft instead now.
[*] Updated level 4-1 with the minor changes that have occured on the actual levels to keep it consistent.
[*] Fixed audio settings not loading correctly causing it to default every time you open the game.
[*] Added some addition spikes to the first boss to stop the player fully cheesing it.
[*] Cleaned up some bits on the cutscene after level 2-2 to hopefully fix the game crashes.
[*] Added a cutscene state to the player to stop them from moving.
[*] More spikes have had their collisions updated. Should be possible to grab the crown on level 2-1 again now.
[*] Added the cutscenes to the level selection to allow for more rigerous testing.
[*] Log files should now be accessible from the games installation directory.
[/list]

notes.title: 04/09/25 - Hidden Optimisations
notes.content:
A smaller update this time around targeting a few 'quick wins' to implement.

[list]
[*] Add iFrame mechanic to powerless form of player. This should fix the game crashes when colliding with enemies at that point of the game.
[*] The pause menu should now display over everything, inclduing the death transition effect.
[*] Tiny performance optimisation (only noticable on slower machines) through increased used of static typing.
[*] All mechanic based tutorial prompts should now be in-game at the relevent point.
[*] Tutorial level removed as it is now obselete.
[*] Main menu buttons re-organised slightly.
[*] Added discord presence related stuff.
[*] Steam should no longer be making you download both Linux and Windows versions of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: 23/08/25 - Extermination
notes.content:
I was going to wait until I had some more content to release these fixes but as the list kept growing I thought it would be better to release it now. Some stuff here may hint to changes coming soon.

* Add some 'tutorial prompts' into the actual levels (still WIP).
* FIX test audio sound crashing the game.
* FIX a few out of bounds skips on level 5-1. Some skips likely still exist here.
* The spikes on 5-2 now go at 80% of the speed.
* FIXES for level 4-2 - Add overhang above buildings above camera boundaries to stop players getting on top of the end 2 buildings. Moved the scaffold tilemap down 2 pixels. Add player standing collision layer to brick buildings near the end to stop player falling under the map.
* FIX (hopefully) Slime could get stuck on the players head without triggering the player getting hurt.
* FIX some spikes didn't have new collisions set correctly.
* Raise the scaffolding tilemap on level 3-3 + added extra hazards to try an avoid a bug where you can be stuck ducking.
* Fixed collision on the thorns for the swamp levels.
* Fixed (I think) being able to move the camera at the start of level 3-1.
* It's no longer possible to ground stomp while on a wall as this had some unintended side effects.
* The player can no longer perform a wall jump in the air while ground stomping.
* Finally fixed (90% sure) zlippern (the penguin) jittering back and forth randomly.
* Player should no longer look like they are floating on a corner of a wall.

notes.title: 16/08/25 - QOL
notes.content:
Ontop of a couple of annoying bugs, some quality of life changes have been implemented.

[list]
[*] Added test language to cutscenes.
[*] Change font for cutscenes to something more reader friendly.
[*] FIXED - player could trigger the cutscene before reaching the top which ended with the game crashing.
[*] FIXED - player could keep the ducking collision box in the air or on the wall in some situations (player can no longer drop through platforms as a result).
[*] Main layout for world 5 boss now completed. Only a few minor gameplay additions to add now!
[*] The player no longer instantly stops moving when connecting with a wall but instead their speed will quickly decelerate to 0 meaning you will slide up the wall very slightly making it feel less sticky.
[/list]

notes.title: 28/07/25 - Quick Fixes
notes.content:
Just a couple of quick fixes to implement to remove some annoying bugs that make certain aspects unplayable.

[list]
[*] FIXED ducking messing collisions with springs and spikes across all levels.
[*] FIXED World 5 boss now spawns in the correct place (so you can actually finish the level).
[*] FIXED The player was unable to duck and drop through some of the slopes that they should have been able to.
[*] ADD more to the layout of world 5 boss. (still WIP but getting there).
[/list]

notes.title: 24/07/25 - Future Foundations
notes.content:
This time round I began creating a pathway to add additional languages to the game in the future, as well as completing the main mechanics for the next boss level.

[list]
[*] Started laying the foundations for future localisation. Use the "TEST" British flag button on the main menu to see some changes.
[*] FIXED: Clicking a scene changing menu button multiple times would cause the game to crash.
[*] World 5 level 2 now contains a boss and can now be completed (level design still unfinished).
[*] FIXED: The player can no longer use multiple quick wall jumps to permanently increase the speed cap while the player is in the air.
[*] Adjusted the start time of the game music to now start AFTER the saved settings have loaded.
[*] Game icon has been replaced & now visible on the exe file.
[/list]

notes.title: 02/07/25 - Despaghettification
notes.content:
As I'm sure most developers are aware... You fix/change 1 thing and break 5 others. At some point I managed to break my fragile ducking collisions code. So this update focuses on me reimplementing it in a much more robust way.

[list]
[*] FIXED: Non-directional jump off the wall allowed the player to climb indefinitely.
[*] FIXED BUT NEEDS TESTING: Ducking collision was not working as intended. Fixed by using 2 different collision layers on the player + tilemaps. 1 for standing, 1 for ducking.
[*] The player should now be able to duck and drop through the thinner static platform tiles that do not require breaking with a ground stomp (Except for level 3-3).
[*] ADJUST: Various things, such as Death zones at the bottom of levels and enemies now detect the new collision layer for a ducking player.
[*] Additional progress made on level 5-2 + FIXED level was inaccessible on level select without a mouse click. Still very WIP and cannot finish.
[*] REMOVED: 1 tilemap transition in Level 5-1 when going backwards. This is not required and most of the time resulted in the player being stuck inside a tile.
[*] Cleared a bunch of unused functions and variables from the player script.
[/list]

notes.title: 25/06/25 - Sticky Mechanics
notes.content:
It's been a hot minute! Mainly due to a short break but back at it now. This update has 2 major mechanical changes among a few other pieces.

[list]
[*] The players interactions with walls has now been reworked. The player will still stick to the wall but will now only slide down if you press down. This should give the player [b]ALOT[/b] more control and eliminate some pesky collision bugs that could not be fixed with the old implementation.
[*] Changed enemy hit cooldowns for a player iFrame window instead to stop instances of being hit by multiple things at the same time.
[*] iFrame lasts for 0.75 seconds as opposed to the 0.2 seconds for the old hit cooldown.
[*] Added Level 5-1 to level select screen.
[*] Added 'biome specific' versions of the basic slime enemy + minor animation update for them across all variants. Also added a small amount of glow and made them slightly larger.
[*] Added 'some' enemies to level 5-1.
[*] Added Level 5-2 (VERY EARLY WORK IN PROGRESS. CURRENTLY CANNOT FINISH LEVEL). This will end up being a boss level.
[*] Boundries added to the top of level 4-3 to stop player falling off (TEMP FIX)
[*] Added UI to level 4-3 and extended the background downwards to cover the screen.
[*] Fixed (sort of) a collision overlap on level 4-2.
[*] Moved the brick structures invisible walls closer to the edge to make more sense on 4-2.
[/list]

notes.title: 04/04/25 - Zoomies
notes.content:
Development progress was significantly slower since the last update, but significant changes to movement have been shipped with it.

[list]
[*] New intro splash to include epilepsy warning.
[*] Player Move/Jump speed + deceleration increased. Camera movement adjusted alongside this (will likely see future tweaks).
[*] Post-Wall jump movement cooldown increased.
[*] Add world enviroment filters across all levels for better colour (Less washed out).
[*] Add a few enemies to World 4 Level 3.
[*] World 5 Level 1 layout complete.
[*] Make Player darker on brighter levels.
[*] Minor tilemap updates to levels 2 & 3 of World 4.
[*] Credits update.
[/list]

notes.title: 03/03/25 - Engine upgrade
notes.content:
With the complete release of Godot 4.4 now in the wild I decided to upgrade to it now rather than create more work later.

[list]
[*] Update engine from Godot 4.3 to 4.4
[*] Tiny optimisations across all scripts. This will result in an upto ~25% increase in performence (Likely only noticable on lower end machines).
[*] Add Pavement and additional building detail to Cityscape Sprites sheet.
[*] Level 4-3 layout completed (Missing assets).
[*] Make slide animation slightly less janky (sometimes it just didn't work).
[*] Fixed Soard enemies clipping through swamp tiles.
[*] Zlippen can now only scale 40 degree slopes. This should stop them getting stuck on hills.
[*] Change gravity calc to in-built function.
[/list]

notes.title: 20/02/25 - Oops!
notes.content:
A bit of a smaller one here. Mainly to rectify the fact that I forgot to add the most up to date version of the level select screen on the live build. A couple of extra little bits that I was working on too.

* Level 4-2 is now accessible from the level select screen.
* Level 4-2 placeholder art has been partially replaced.
* Rocky slimes are now smaller and faster. Player detection range has also been increased.

notes.title: 17/02/25 - Another one!
notes.content:
This build adds another level with placeholder assets usage as well as a large smattering of minor changes + bugfixes.

[list]
[*] Level 4-2 layout completed (Placeholder assets only so far)
[*] Zlippern and Soard enemies can no longer physically collide with themselves.
[*] Bubbles can no longer collide with OTHER entities.
[*] Rocky no longer phsyically collides with the player.
[*] Fix Enemies at the end of level 3-3 jittering in place (thanks to above).
[*] Fix Zipern getting stuck (and sometimes jittering) on slopes. No longer attempts to scale slopes.
[*] Fix Powerless player clipping and getting stuck when reaching the bottom of a wall while sliding.
[*] Fix The player falling into the finish would sometimes cause extra level end screens to spawn when pressing buttons, causing a freeze/crash on repeated presses.
[*] Fix Level end stats were accumalating from world 3 or 4 levels instead of resetting to 0.
[*] Fix collisions on the back side of some corner tiles to stop player from standing inside them.
[*] Fixes On 3-3; Ship won't leave before the player touches it now, Player can't fall out of bounds at both the start and end. Player can no longer survive underwater when the scaffolding drops. 
[*] Fix the player cam glitching out after gaining control on 3-1.
[*] Fix Player should no longer get stuck in the jump animation while going up a slope. Player should feel a bit 'stickier' in general.
[*] Fix invisible blocker just after the down elevator on 4-1.
[*] Added an upwards elevator at the latter stage of 4-1.
[/list]

notes.title: 12/02/25 - Some much needed extra levels!
notes.content:
This time round we have 3 new levels (mainly just the basic layouts) added. A couple of minor bug fixes and re-working bits of code for 1 enemies AI + some tougher bugs.

[list]
[*] Fix respawn bug on level 3-1.
[*] Fix player camera jitter when dying to spikes/thorns.
[*] Zlippern has slightly improved AI to stop it from falling of the edge of platforms to allow it's use in more cases.
[*] Level 3-2 layout completed.
[*] Level 3-3 layout completed.
[*] Level 4-1 layout completed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the timer started before the player gains control on Level 3-1. 
[*] Re-coded intro cutscene jump so it hopefully wont break with any physics changes going forward.
[*] Re-coded the springs to better detect when the player is ground stomping on it so it can properly launch the player conisistenly.
[*] Increased opacity of the main menu text boxes to increase readability.
[/list]

notes.title: 02/02/25 - Bug Hunt
notes.content:
A few level/game breaking bugs arose after the additions of new art and player mechanics. Squashing some of the common ones was the focus of this update, with some other minor additions.

[list]
[*] Level 3-1 layout level is now completed properly. Just needs some additional art to spruce it up.
[*] Altered level layout slightly on tuorial to avoid getting stuck when unducking.
[*] Trying to unduck or jump while sliding no longer stops the player from moving side to side.
[*] Added boundries to level 1-1 and 2-1 to stop player escaping the level.
[*] Fixed invisible boundry on the boss level. Also increased thickness of ceiling boundry to hopefully stop the player from clipping above the boss area.
[*] Fixed an issue where a player could clip into the floor sometimes when allowing the wall slide to reach the floor.
[*] Added restart level option to the pause menu (FINALLY!)
[/list]

notes.title: NEW YEAR NEW sliMEs
notes.content:
Happy new year to everyone! After a short break for the holidays I am back on the dev train. The main focus of this update was to replace a bunch of placeholders and lay the groundwork for future biome variant related assets.

[list]
[*] Partial menu/UI art update. Timer now displays 2 decimals.
[*] Added Vsync option.
[*] Fixed pause menu not displaying on World 3-1 and added the UI.
[*] Fixed a crash for altered player.
[*] Additional menu navigation for non-mouse users (specifically when completing a level).
[*] Fixed occasional blank screen when starting the tutorial.
[*] Add adjusted mouse cursor while hovering buttons with a mouse for readability.
[*] Added a new finish sign to replace the placeholder. In future each biome will have its own variation.
[*] Replaced the base sprites for the 4 non-boss enemies. They will also have different variations for each biome in future.
[*] Adjusted the movement logic for Zlippern to feel slippier and zip around more as the name indicates.
[*] Fixed hole on level 2 is now actually a hole and is instant kill again.
[*] Can no longer get stuck under the scaffolding after beating the slime boss.
[*] Minor additions to level 3-1 (Still a WIP level).
[*] New slide mechanic added for the player.
[/list]

With a new little'un added to my family, development was halted for a couple of weeks but I'm now back on track with the start of some new content and some important bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Added the start of the swamp biome tileset.
[*] Added first powerless player level WIP created (level 3-1) using new swamp tileset.
[*] FIXED player jumping during cutscene.
[*] FIXED Level progression crash when not using level select.
[*] FIXED "Ground Stomp Unlocked" showing on the incorrect level.
[*] FIXED "boss camera" carrying over to the next level when not using level select.
[*] FIXED Music player not correctly changing in some circumstances.
[*] Added new song for the cave biome levels.
[*] Changed old level 3-1 to TEST on level select screen.
[*] Added additional mapping to intro cutscene to stop immersion breaking.
[/list]

notes.title: 06/11/24 Bug Crushing Update
notes.content:
In an attempt to recreate a bug, I ended up finding a few more. Also a QOL feature added.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where some levels (mainly hard levels) were showing nothing after fading to black.
[*] Added some hitbox adjustments to stop players becoming immune to instant death spikes.
[*] Increased hitbox change speed to hopefully mitigate issues where the player could clip through things.
[*] (QOL) Made cutscenes skippable by pressing the pause button twice and (FIX) removed the pause menu that was crashing the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the player to clip under the platform in the post world 2 cutscene.
[*] Minor fixes to the Z-indexes of a few objects.
[/list]

notes.title: 01/11/24 Update
notes.content:
Some more small additions on the art side as well as a new mechanic and more accessible menus!

[list]
[*] Additional cave props created and added.
[*] Beginning of scaffolding based prop creation.
[*] Replace breakable boxes for each biome.
[*] Add ducking mechanic.
[*] Update cutscene tilemaps.
[*] ALL menus should navigatable by both keyboard and controller now.
[/list]

notes.title: 19/10/24 Art update 1 part 2
notes.content:
A continuation of the art update released recently. More art should be on the way soon!

[list]
[*] Lowered the brightness of 'outdoor' level finishes.
[*] Added a new Scaffolding tilemap to replace old one.
[*] Finished replacing placeholder timemaps with new tilemaps. More to come in future.
[*] Added a new song to level 5 + hard (Will not be used for this level in future but it's there to listen to for now.)
[/list]

notes.title: 12/10/24 Art Update 1
notes.content:
I've had some time and inspiration to try and replace some of the games many placeholder assets in this update as well as a bit of convenience.

[list]
[*] Updated the pause menu to include the settings so you don't need to go back to the main menu.
[*] Added a new version of the grassland tilemap (replacing on all levels still WIP).
[*] Added a new Cave tilemap (replacing on all levels still WIP).
[*] Added the beginings of inserting props (Replacing the old billboard on the intro cutscene for example).
[*] As the new tilemaps have slopes, the player now snaps to slopes to avoid very jank movement.
[/list] 
Remember that this is still early days and so these new art assets may still change yet, but the new stuff feels a lot closer to how I want the game to end up looking. Here's a quick side by side comparison of the changes.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p4SDL9k.png[/img]

notes.title: 03/10/2024 - HOTFIX
notes.content: A bug has been discovered that broke the game when trying to pause on a moving platform (Don't actually know how long this has been the case). This hotfix will stop that from happening. (Famous last words?)

notes.title: 03/10/24 Update
notes.content:
A few little extra bits of content added. Mainly some cleanup from the last update and added a new level that uses the recoil jump. 

* Add level 4 hard mode.

* Add level 5 normal and hardmode.

* Fix normal level progression looping level 4.

* There was a few cases of objects being partially or fully behind the background due to the Godot 4.3 tilemap changes. These should all be rectified now.

* Cleaned up what goes into the save file and cleaned some redundant code.

notes.title: 18/09/2024 Update
notes.content:
Not a major change in terms of how the game looks or feels to play but an important update for future development.

[list]
[*] Move the project from Godot 4.2.2 to Godot 4.3. Some node conversions have occured as a result of this.
[*] Cleaned up some of the scene trees.
[*] Remove a bunch of tiles that the player will never be able to see. This  will cause a tiny performance improvment.
[*] Added a patch notes panel to the main menu.
[*] Enabled MSAA at 2x and 'Snap 2D transforms to pixel' in the project settings. The result should be some slightly cleaner text and a small reduction of jagged edges across the game.
[/list]

notes.title: 15/09/24 Update
notes.content:
Todays update focuses on completing a bit of content I wanted to be in the intial alpha release.

[list]
[*] Added adversary reveal to the cutscene.
[*] Added an animation to go with the previosuly random sound effect that launches the play in the cutscene.
[*] FIXED level 4 finish frozen black screen if done via level select.
[/list]

The alpha is now in a state where I feel I can sit down start planning the route to a beta state. In the meantime, I do plan on releasing a level or 2 (and maybe another boss) that makes use of the recoil jump mechanic so you can use it outside of the tutorial.

notes.title: 14/09/24 Update
notes.content:
Just a few changes mainly to assist players with wall jumping. This mechanic was not really intended to be difficult but in some cases players found it near impossible to perform correctly or consistantly.

[list]
[*] X and Y velocities both increased slightly to make wall to wall jumps slightly easier
[*] A very short buffer has been added to allow the player to move away from the wall before pressing jump.
[*] Adjusted some of the wall jumps across the levels to make them far less punishing (including the hellish tutorial part!)
[*] Sliding down a wall is now slightly slower and has a very tiny speed increment that is capped to make the walls feel less slippy.
[*] Added a link to Godot's Licensing page within the credits.
[*] The menu button on the credits screen can now be pressed with keyboard and controller.
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest now live!
notes.content:
We are officially live with the playtest. A small update to go along with it that:

[list]
[*] Enables more menus to be navigated using the keyboard or controller.
[*] Fixed a couple of extrenal link buttons.
[*] Added a little welcome and some external links to the main menu.
[/list]
